name: Exp_iStochKomposter
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom iStochKomposter indicator, a Stochastic-based oscillator with overbought/oversold levels. It opens buy positions on oversold signals and sell positions on overbought signals, with configurable close-on-opposite-signal logic. Position sizing uses a flexible money management system supporting lot, free margin, balance, and loss-based modes.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义iStochKomposter指标（一种带超买超卖水平的随机振荡器）的信号进行交易。在超卖信号时开多仓，在超买信号时开空仓，并支持反向信号平仓逻辑。仓位管理采用灵活的资金管理模式，支持固定手数、可用保证金、余额和亏损比例等多种模式。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于自定义iStochKomposter指标的均值回归交易，该指标本质上是一个改进的随机振荡器，结合了ATR周期参数。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区（buffer 1）在指定信号柱上产生非零且非空值时，产生买入信号；当指标下轨缓冲区（buffer 0）在指定信号柱上产生非零且非空值时，产生卖出信号。出场条件分为两类：一是通过反向信号平仓（买入信号触发卖出平仓，卖出信号触发买入平仓），二是通过固定的止损和止盈水平。仓位管理方面，EA提供了五种资金管理模式：固定手数、基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于亏损后可用保证金、基于亏损后余额。EA还实现了新柱检测机制，避免在同一K线内重复交易，并通过Recount标志确保信号读取失败时能够重新计算。此外，当同时允许开仓和平仓但当前无平仓信号时，EA会向前回溯历史柱寻找最近的反向信号来决定是否平仓。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy is centered on mean reversion trading using the custom iStochKomposter indicator, which is essentially an enhanced Stochastic oscillator combined with an ATR period parameter. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when the indicator's upper buffer (buffer 1) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE on the specified signal bar; a sell signal is generated when the lower buffer (buffer 0) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE on the signal bar. Exit conditions are twofold: closing via opposite signals (buy signal triggers sell position close, sell signal triggers buy position close), and through fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. For position sizing, the EA offers five money management modes: fixed lot, based on free margin, based on balance, based on post-loss free margin, and based on post-loss balance. The EA implements a new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated trades within the same candle, and uses a Recount flag to ensure signal recalculation when buffer reads fail. Additionally, when both opening and closing are allowed but no close signal exists, the EA backtracks through historical bars to find the nearest opposite signal to determine whether to close existing positions.

parameters.description_en: Allow buy-side close (close sell on opposite signal)

parameters.description_en: Allow sell-side close (close buy on opposite signal)

pros: 实现了新柱检测机制，避免同一K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易风险
提供五种资金管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好的交易者
止损止盈参数可配置，且止盈是止损的两倍，具备正向风险回报比
信号读取失败时通过Recount标志自动重试，增强了健壮性
开仓和平仓开关独立控制，允许精细化的策略配置
pros_en: Implements new bar detection to prevent repeated trades within the same candle, reducing overtrading risk
Offers five money management modes providing flexibility for different risk appetites
Configurable stop-loss and take-profit with a 1:2 risk-reward ratio (TP=2000, SL=1000)
Automatic signal recalculation via Recount flag on buffer read failure enhances robustness
Independent open/close switches allow fine-grained strategy configuration
cons: ATR_Period变量未声明为input，无法在策略测试器中优化，也不可见于EA参数面板
历史柱回溯查找平仓信号（第142行循环）缺乏上限保护，可能造成性能问题
未进行持仓检查，可能在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓导致仓位叠加
缺乏点差过滤，在点差较大时仍可能开仓，增加交易成本
依赖外部自定义指标iStochKomposter，增加了部署复杂性和依赖风险
cons_en: ATR_Period is not declared as input, making it invisible in the EA parameter panel and unoptimizable in the strategy tester
The historical bar backtracking loop (line 142) lacks an upper bound, potentially causing performance issues on charts with extensive history
No position check before opening trades, risking duplicate positions in the same direction
No spread filter — trades may open during high-spread conditions, increasing transaction costs
Depends on the external custom indicator iStochKomposter, increasing deployment complexity and dependency risk
improvements: 将ATR_Period声明为input变量，使其可在参数面板中配置和优化
添加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致仓位过度叠加
为历史柱回溯循环添加最大搜索柱数限制，防止性能退化
improvements_en: Declare ATR_Period as an input variable to make it configurable and optimizable in the strategy tester
Add position check logic before opening trades to prevent duplicate same-direction positions
Add a maximum bar search limit to the historical backtracking loop to prevent performance degradation

risk_points: 缺乏持仓检查，可能同方向重复开仓导致仓位叠加风险
止损1000点较大，在小周期或高波动品种上可能造成较大单笔亏损
历史柱回溯循环无上限保护，极端情况下可能导致EA卡顿或超时
risk_points_en: No position check before opening, risking position accumulation in the same direction
Large stop-loss of 1000 points may cause significant single-trade losses on volatile instruments
Unbounded historical bar backtracking loop may cause EA lag or timeout in extreme cases

It opens buy positions on oversold signals and sell positions on overbought signals, with configurable close-on-opposite-signal logic. Position sizing uses a flexible money management system supporting lot, free margin, balance, and loss-based modes.
